title: Income Annuities Installment Schedule, Cost-of-Living Increases and Withholding Provisions
content:
## Article 1 — When installments are paid

1.1 Installments on an Ashgrove Income Annuities contract are paid on each scheduled payment date while the contract status is income active, survivor continuing or beneficiary continuing.

1.2 While a death claim is pending, only installments that fell due on or before the date of death, held or unpaid, are issued, to the person entitled to them.

1.3 An installment is issued only while the contract status is income active, death claim pending, survivor continuing or beneficiary continuing. The status is the one shown on the record of the contract the installment belongs to.

| Contract status | Installment may be issued? |
|---|---|
| Income active | Yes |
| Death claim pending | Yes — only installments that fell due on or before the date of death, held or unpaid |
| Survivor continuing | Yes |
| Beneficiary continuing | Yes |
| Applied, payments suspended, completed, cancelled in the free look, declined | No |

## Article 2 — Cost-of-living increases

2.1 **No longer in force.** Where a cost-of-living rate was chosen, the installment increased by that rate, compounded, on each contract anniversary from the tier's first cost-of-living increase anniversary onward, rounded to the cent — this clause has been superseded by the current basis and is no longer in force. The tier's cost-of-living options and first-increase anniversary remain the tier's figures.

## Article 3 — Taxable part of an installment

3.1 **No longer in force.** On a non-qualified contract where the tier's exclusion ratio applies, each installment was split into a tax-free part equal to the installment multiplied by the exclusion ratio and a taxable remainder, until the total tax-free amount equalled the purchase amount, after which the whole installment was taxable; IRA installments were fully taxable — this clause has been superseded by the current basis and is no longer in force.

## Article 4 — Federal withholding

4.1 **No longer in force.** Federal tax was withheld at the rate on the owner's latest withholding election, and with no election on file the tier's default withholding method for periodic payments applied — this clause has been superseded by the current basis and is no longer in force.

4.2 The federal tax withheld from an installment is its taxable part multiplied by the withholding rate, rounded to the cent.

4.3 A new withholding election applies to installments whose payment date is at least the tier's withholding election cutoff in business days after the election is received; earlier installments use the prior election.

*Hypothetical timing.* With a 10-business-day cutoff, an election received 10 business days before a payment date governs that installment; an election received 9 business days before leaves that installment on the prior election and governs the following one.

superseded_clauses: Where a cost-of-living rate was chosen, the installment increases by that rate, compounded, on each contract anniversary from cola_first_increase_anniversary onward, rounded to the cent.

On a non-qualified contract where exclusion_ratio_applies is true, each installment is split into a tax-free part equal to the installment times the exclusion ratio and a taxable remainder, until the total tax-free amount equals the purchase amount, after which the whole installment is taxable; IRA installments are fully taxable.
Federal tax is withheld at the rate on the owner's latest withholding election; with no election on file the withholding_default_periodic method applies.
